title: Interaction Response Stability
summary: The HelpDesk bot now protects slow Discord slash commands from timing out while the requested action continues running.
added: Automatic interaction acknowledgement for slow slash commands before Discord's timeout window expires.
Safe follow-up handling when a command finishes after it has already been acknowledged.
changed: Commands that take longer because of Discord API delays should no longer show 'Delta HelpDesk did not respond in time' before completing.
Ticket-related commands can finish normally after the auto-acknowledgement instead of failing the visible Discord interaction.
Ticket close actions are excluded from auto-defer when they need to open the close-reason modal.
